text:
Let’s compute step-by-step.

1. Asia/Tokyo UTC offset = +9  
   Australia/Sydney UTC offset = +10  

2. Target time = source_time + (target_offset − source_offset)  
   Target time = 07:00 + (10 − 9)  
   Target time = 07:00 + 1 hour = 08:00  

3. Same date (no day crossing here).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 08:00
